_schema._: Single source of truth for hypothesis STATE. Narrative analysis stays in hypotheses.md / validated-hypotheses.md; this file holds status, evidence type, confidence, sources, history. Manage via tools/scripts/hypotheses.py (add / set / validate / render) — `set` writes history automatically. Generated view: output/registry.md.
_schema.title: one-line hypothesis statement
_schema.status: draft | testing | confirmed | refuted | reframed | parked
flags: data_inconsistency — sources disagree, confidence capped at 0.6
